title: Localization normalization of the scalar pullback mate
statement: For a prime l, finite extension E of Q_l, every scheme map f:X→Y and n≥0, let r0 be an ordinary restriction/direct-image comparison heterogeneously equal to the inverse canonical identity-on-sections comparison, and r the corresponding fixed derived comparison, heterogeneously equal to sfDerivedImageRestriction. For every cochain complex P of level-n normalized DVR modules on Y, the inverse derived mate of r.inv at Q(P), followed by the restricted low-level pullback localization factor and the restriction factor, equals the high-level pullback of the restriction localization factor, followed by its pullback localization factor and Q of the ordinary inverse mate of r0.inv at P. There is no coefficient system, evaluation functor or quotient-system transition in this statement.

source.place: Tags 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition) and 0D6J (lemma-modules-abelian-unbounded), together with the canonical derived adjunction unit formula. Agent-written specialization to the finite scalar comparison.

proof.text: Use derivedη_fac_app at the homotopy quotient to compute the transpose of a localized cochain map under the canonical derived adjunction. After cancelling the quotient identity factors it is Q of the ordinary transpose followed by the all-complex right-derived unit.

Apply the high-level derived adjunction Hom bijection to the proposed mate equation. Compute the ordinary inverse-mate transpose and the derived inverse-mate transpose using unit_mateEquiv_symm. Move the localization factor across the specified derived comparison by naturality. Substitute compactSupportScalarDirectNormalization, then use naturality of the exact restriction localization factor. Injectivity proves equality; transport both ordinary restriction functors with their additive/exactness instances to the equal adjacent-quotient presentations. No preservation of K-injectives by restriction is asserted.

proof_origin.place: Construction 4.1 and paragraph preceding Lemma 4.10, with canonical mate and localization-factor calculations.

lean.statement:
theorem integralScalarPullback_mateNormalization {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (r₀ : normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n) ⋙
        proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 2)) ≅
      proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) ⋙
        normalizedDVRModuleRes l E Y (Nat.le_succ n))
    (hr₀ : HEq r₀ (proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison f
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionTransition l E (n + 1))).symm)
    (r : normalizedDVRRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n) ⋙
        proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 2)) ≅
      proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) ⋙
        normalizedDVRRes l E Y (Nat.le_succ n))
    (hr : HEq r
      (sfDerivedImageRestriction f (Padic.coefficientExtensionTransition l E (n + 1))))
    (P : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ) :
    ((mateEquiv (finiteAdj l E f n) (finiteAdj l E f (n + 1))).symm
        (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ r.inv)).natTrans.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
      (normalizedDVRRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).map
        ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors
          (sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f)).hom.app P) ≫
      (normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
    (finiteDerivedPullback l E (n + 1) f).map
        ((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E Y (Nat.le_succ n)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 2)) f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        (((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E Y (Nat.le_succ n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
          ((mateEquiv
            (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)))
            (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f
              (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 2)))).symm
          (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ r₀.inv)).natTrans (.up ℤ)).app P)
